sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Aman Soni - Advocate for petitioner.
Ms. Shikha Sharma - Government Advocate for State.

Order 
Petitioner has filed this petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. (New Section 528 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023) for quashing of FIR registered at Police Station Piplani, District Bhopal at Crime No.373/2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC read with Section 3(1)(w)(ii) & 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
2. Counsel appearing for petitioner submitted that respondent No.2 is adult and FIR has only been lodged to put pressure on petitioner to marry her.
Version of prosecutrix is full of exaggeration.
Petitioner has falsely been implicated on basis of material available in the case diary and evidence collected by prosecution.
No offence of rape is made out.
No prudent person will believe on basis of allegations made against the applicant that he had forcibly committed intercourse with prosecutrix and raped her repeatedly.
In these circumstances prayer is made for quashing of charge-sheet issued NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6018 2 MCRC-36835-2024 against the petitioner.

In support of his contention learned counsel placed reliance on judgments passed by Apex Court in case of Pramod Suryabhan Pawar Vs. State of Maharashtra & Another, (2019) 9 SCC 608 and Mahesh Damu Khare Vs. State of Maharashtra & Another, passed in SLP (Cri.) 4326/2018 and also orders passed by this Court in cases of Mohd. Fahim Khan Vs. State of M.P. & Others (W.P.
No.3535/2023) decided on 15/06/2023 and Ramakant Vishwakarma Vs. State of M.P. & Another ,
(M.Cr.C.No.61009/2022) decided on 13/03/2024.

sentences.text: Government Advocate appearing for State supported the prosecution version and submitted that prosecutrix has stated that applicant had committed rape on her.
There is no reason to disbelieve the prosecutrix at this stage.
There is enough material, which points towards commission of offence by the petitioner.
It is submitted that Court may not interfere in the charge-sheet filed by the Police.
It is prayed that petition be dismissed.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Police Station Piplani, District Bhopal has registered FIR at Crime No.373/2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC.
As per the FIR, prosecutrix, who is resident of Bhopal is aged about 24 years and Nurse by profession.
Through instagram and social media friendship was developed between petitioner and prosecutrix.
On 01/09/2023 petitioner who is resident of Mumbai is said to have visited Bhopal.
He took prosecutrix in Convival Classic Hotel and made promise to marry her and establish physical relationship.
They stayed in Hotel for one day and then petitioner returned back to Mumbai.
Petitioner is repeatedly said to have NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6018 3 MCRC-36835-2024 establish physical relationship with the prosecutrix, but made excuses for not marrying her.
On 24/03/2024 prosecutrix went to petitioner at Mumbai and stayed with her for two days.
There also physical relationship was established.
When she returned to Bhopal, petitioner did not talk with her and later refused to marry her.
Over this, FIR has been registered.
Petitioner has also filed complaint that prosecutrix is blackmailing him and putting pressure for doing marriage.

6. In her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. before Court, prosecutrix has stated that both of them had agreed that they will do marriage, then only they will establish relationship with each other.
Later on petitioner took her to a Hotel in Bhopal and establish physical relationship with her that he will marry her and on various excuses refused to marry her.

7. Question before this Court is whether there was false promise to marry the prosecutrix and thereafter physical relationship has been established or merely there is breach of promise on part of petitioner.
8. Facts indicates that prosecutrix is major.
Petitioner and prosecutrix established friendship on instagram.
Thereafter, promise was made to marry and relationship was established many times.
Prosecutrix also visited to petitioner's house and lived there for two days and there also relationship was established.
Nothing has been stated by prosecutrix that she has been deceived by the promise.
Only bald allegation is made that petitioner made promise to marry and establish relationship.
Relationship between petitioner and prosecutrix span for a long time.
No FIR was lodged immediately.
Even when petitioner did not marry the prosecutrix for some time, she continued to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6018 4 MCRC-36835-2024 establish relationship with petitioner.
9. Aforesaid facts shows that case was not of false promise to marry.
There is nothing on record to show that prosecutrix was deceived by false promise to marry.

It may be a case of breach of promise,
but is not a case of false promise to marry and deceiving woman and establishing physical Sampurnanand Prasad Maurya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92720754/
2 relationship.
10.

sentences.text: In view of same, petition filed by petitioner is allowed.
Charge- sheet and its consequential proceedings against petitioner arising out of Crime No.373/2024 registered at Police Station Piplani, District Bhopal is quashed.
11. Petition is allowed and disposed off.
